findings.reason: without a named entry point (the CLI subcommand or stage that runs the regroup) the node's builder cannot know what invokes the regroup, and the node's done-when ("a live JT-60SA run leaves flux loop 7 alone…") cannot be run at all.
findings.text: §9 says the group key "becomes kind-aware" in `detect_signal_sources` "and a regroup beside it makes each existing source hold one kind", but names no production caller for the regroup, and the host it is placed beside cannot do it: `detect_signal_sources` queries only `WHERE s.status = discovered AND NOT EXISTS { (s)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(:SignalSource) }` (imas_codex/discovery/signals/parallel.py:1790), so a second invocation is a no-op on the already-grouped sources the regroup must move; its sole production caller is the signals-discovery preflight (parallel.py:5386), which runs before workers as part of a fresh scan

findings.reason: the node extends a test file shared with the preceding node, so a builder can deliver a broken or unrun suite and still satisfy the gate; the done-when needs the pytest clause the §6 edit dropped.
findings.text: `jt60sa-sensor-geometry` declares `tests/discovery/test_sensor_geometry.py` among its write paths but its done-when ("each JT-60SA magnetic sensor the inventory joined carries geometry per operation phase …, and the fragment lists every position or angle that differs from imas-ambix beyond 1 mm or 0.1°") never requires those tests to run, unlike its predecessor `sensor-geometry-graph`, whose done-when opens "the tests pass"

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — the DD anchors §9 relies on resolve (`magnetics/flux_loop/type` structure and `magnetics/flux_loop/indices_differential` INT_1D both found in the DD), the imas-ambix paths §6 cites exist (maps/jt-60sa/maps/ holds magnetics.json etc., machine_description/ holds OP1 and OP2), and `detect_signal_sources`/`_accessor_to_source_key` resolve at imas_codex/discovery/signals/parallel.py:1738–1747.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — `jt60sa-sensor-geometry` now declares `tests/discovery/test_sensor_geometry.py` as a write path but its done-when never requires that suite to run or pass.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the §6 edit replaced the fragment-only write path with durable repo paths (the shared module `imas_codex/discovery/static/geometry.py`, the test file) beside the evidence fragment, and §9's `measurement-kind-sources.html` sits under `docs/evidence/fragments/`; the earlier evidence_paths-1 finding is answered.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §6 and §9 introduce no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or version tags; the only version strings are §2's bundle snapshot, which is data.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §9's kind-aware regroup is described but names no production caller, and the function it is placed beside structurally cannot perform it.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — each of `sensor-geometry-inventory`, `sensor-geometry-graph`, `jt60sa-sensor-geometry` and `measurement-kind-sources` names one deliverable.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the three gates carry the cross-plan wiring (g-scc-1 requires external-map-rules#s5, g-scc-3 requires external-map-rules#s3, g-scc-2 gates §8 on this plan's own §9), and every target resolves: external-map-rules declares §s1–§s5, jt60sa-discovery-completion declares §s56, and plan-blocks names jt60sa-imas-maps.
